build_parse_ragflow_model: parse a RAGFlow model name in format ragflow/chat/{chat_id}/{model} or ragflow/agent/{agent_id}/{model} into endpoint type, entity id, and model name
build_get_complete_url: build the complete RAGFlow API URL from api_base, model name, and endpoint type for chat or agent completions
build_validate_environment: validate environment and set up Authorization and Content-Type headers for RAGFlow API requests
build_transform_request: transform request by extracting the actual model name from RAGFlow format and delegating to OpenAI-compatible request transformer
build_get_provider_info: get OpenAI-compatible provider info including api_base, api_key, and custom provider from RAGFlow model name
